amendement n° 2 du 20 février 2020 à l'accord de rapprochement de T-Mobile et de Sprint : indemnisation de T-Mobile par SoftBank après la réalisation, sans montant ni plafond écrits ici
quote: Pursuant to the Amendment, SoftBank has also agreed to indemnify T-Mobile and its subsidiaries following the closing of the Merger Transactions against (i) any monetary losses arising out of or resulting from certain specified matters and (ii) the loss of value to T-Mobile and its subsidiaries arising out of or resulting from cessation of access to spectrum of Sprint or its subsidiaries ("Lost Spectrum") under certain circumstances, subject to limitations and qualifications contained in the Amendment.

note: lettre-accord du 20 février 2020 : remise sans contrepartie de 48 751 557 actions T-Mobile après la fusion, SoftBank devant détenir environ 24 % du capital dilué de T-Mobile ; réémission conditionnelle des mêmes actions si le cours moyen atteint 150 $ (ou 160 $). Actions reçues en échange des actions Sprint, pas une opération primaire de financement : aucune arête
quote: Pursuant to the Letter Agreement, SoftBank has agreed to cause its applicable affiliates to surrender to T-Mobile, for no additional consideration, an aggregate of 48,751,557 shares of T-Mobile Common Stock (such number of shares, the "SoftBank Specified Shares Amount"), effective immediately following the Effective Time (as defined in the Business Combination Agreement). Immediately following such surrender, Deutsche Telekom and SoftBank are expected to hold approximately 43% and 24%, respectively, of the fully diluted shares of T-Mobile Common Stock
